DramaBox Reinterpretations — reference-guided best-of-8

Each embedded DramaBox clip is reinterpreted by MOSS-TTS-4.55B voice-acting-v2 (the base checkpoint for our LoRAs): the original audio is fed back as the reference together with its own GENERAL/SCRIPT prompt, and the model regenerates the same line as a batched group of 8 candidates. Candidates are ranked by emotional similarity to the original × inverse WER; the top 3 are shown next to the original. Regenerating and reward-ranking cleans up disfluencies and mistakes while staying faithful to the original emotion.
